landing.title: TrueCost — what a loan actually costs
headings: Know what your loan really costs.

resultHeading: Public reference A is the cheaper borrowing.
comparison.resultExcerpt: RECOMMENDATION Public reference A is the cheaper borrowing. 8.50% effective APR against 8.90% — a gap of 0.40 percentage points once fees, GST and any bundled premium are counted. Over 10 years that is ₹25,794 you keep. WHAT IS DRIVING THE GAP This one is the rate itself: 0.40 of the 0.40 points is interest, and charges barely move it. Fee-haggling will not rescue the more expensive offer. What to ask for. Charges alone cannot close this — Public reference B would need 0.40 percentage points off the rate to match Public reference A. That is a repricing, not a discount, so it is the harder ask. RBI bars foreclosure and prepayment charges on floating-rate home loans to individual borrowers, so you can prepay any amount for free. The rate can reset, though — every figure here assumes it never does.
